configurations.rationale: Test whether earlier perturbation offsets the slower large-case search at T=0.01 while retaining its medium-case signal. The two single-factor effects reverse direction between the large and medium cases; no improvement is presumed.

Test complementarity or interference between a lower-mean destruction window and earlier perturbation. Both single changes lower the large-case mean but worsen the medium-case mean; their joint effect is unknown.

schedule_policy: Nine existing OFAT base lines first, in their original order. Fresh stage RNG shuffles NEW configurations only within each instance-seed block. Historical controls were not interleaved with new runs.
target_scope: Frozen published and maximum nominal baseline objectives; neither implies optimality.
timing_scope: Full per-cell search wall budget. Nominal observations exclude overshoot. Misses are censored at their own horizon. No pooled mixed-budget time.
inference: Exploratory post-OFAT combinations, three paired seeds. Combined-versus-base performance is not proof of interaction. Four-corner paired contrasts are identifiable only on tail cases with existing simple effects. No significance or holdout claim; historical controls belong to a prior stage.
